crime_highlights: Charles Neel obtaining a knife and stabbing January Lapuz in an attempt to defend himself
Ms. Lapuz suffered numerous stab wounds, resulting in significant injury, specifically to her vertebral artery and jugular vein, as a result of which she died
he used more force than was reasonable in the circumstances
Mr. Neel fled the residence after threatening a neighbour's friend with a knife
rationale_highlights: his aboriginal heritage, as referred to in the pre-sentence report with a Gladue component
his aboriginal background and the fact that his mother, who abandoned him, was a residential school survivor and that this has had continuing effects upon subsequent generations, including Mr. Neel
I must pay attention to the circumstances of Mr. Neel's aboriginal heritage as it relates to this offence
note: Court only says it must pay attention; effect on sentence not stated.

crime_highlights: Mr. Leon returned and assaulted her by punching her on her head and face
J.M.E. sustained abrasions of her forehead, bruising to her right eye and right cheek, bruising on her neck and multiple bruises on both knees and her right hand
The injuries to her vaginal area caused significant pain and took approximately three weeks to heal
The bruise to her right eye was also very painful and took about a month to heal
rationale_highlights: Both of Mr. Leon's grandmothers attended residential schools
Mr. Leon's apparent lack of appreciation for the consequences of his actions and lack of remorse needs to be considered in the context of his own background
he lacks the advantage of being raised in a stable home environment
He was raised in an environment where abuse of drugs and alcohol and violence were the norm, not the exception
note: Effect is on assessing remorse; sentence effect stated only generally elsewhere.

crime_highlights: Mr. Kelly, apparently unhappy with some issue regarding his telephone privileges, wrote down the home address of a correctional officer on his hand in ink
He put his hand up to the glass window of the room within which he was held in a manner that enabled the guard to see the address so written
he was concerned about his family being put at risk
his family was placed in emotional turmoil
rationale_highlights: Mr. Kelly, I think it fair to say, was, as a result of his upbringing, unable to develop any real meaningful relationships in his life

He is, however, a young man who came, as a result of his background, from such a disadvantaged and troubled young life that he lacks, it seems to me, basic skills that many of us have developed to deal with anger and frustration
In balancing all of the factors that I have outlined, I conclude the appropriate sentence for each of these offences is six months' imprisonment
